title: Robust and Interpretable Medical Image Classifiers via Concept Bottleneck Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness against spurious correlations using a curated dataset (NIH-gender) where gender is artificially correlated with specific diseases in the training set (e.g., males with Atelectasis, females with Effusion), and measuring generalization on a test set with the inverse correlation.

Measuring classification performance on datasets (NIH-age and NIH-agemix) designed with explicit age-based confounding factors, where patient age groups (young vs. old) are spuriously correlated with normal or abnormal X-ray diagnoses in the training distribution but inverted in the test distribution.
